roots.label: Screen Map
roots.description: Observe workspace — titled screenshot batches of the anchored window (same as Lab → Observe).

children.label: Start screenshot batch
children.description: Create a new Screen Map batch folder and turn capture mode on. Shots land under screen-maps/.

children.label: Capture screenshot
children.description: Grab the anchored window now and save it into the active batch (auto title shot N). Batch must already be started.

children.label: End screenshot batch
children.description: Close the active Screen Map batch and leave capture mode.

roots.label: One-shots
roots.description: Bench presets played once (mouse clicks). Pause/Stop on the deck while a one-shot runs.

children.label: Gem box tap
children.description: Single tap on the gem box.

children.label: Currency toggle
children.description: Flip top HUD balances ↔ /min rates.

children.label: Health then Attack
children.description: Legacy blind Defense→Health then Attack→Damage clicks.

children.label: Humanize Atk/Def once
children.description: One humanized Attack/Defense upgrade loop.

roots.label: Loops
roots.description: Atoms (reusable procedures) and molecules (compositions / schedules). Stop with Stop / F8.

children.label: Atoms
children.description: Reusable procedures from automations/events/. Start selected runs once.

children.label: Real
children.description: Production Tower / instrumentation atoms.

children.label: Navigation
children.description: Tab ensure + shared list scroll (tab-agnostic).

children.description: Open Attack if needed (skip when already open).

children.description: One tile-row down on the open upgrade list.

children.label: B-roll every 5 minutes

children.description: Play humanize atk def loop (usually disabled).

children.description: Harness / click-logger demos.

children.description: Click-logger SIGNAL band → path A or B.
